clue.text: Encourage groom to make hair look thicker

parts.note: to back someone is to support or encourage them
to comb hair is to groom it

explanation.surface: Advice to a hairdresser on giving a client's hair more volume.
explanation.definitionFit: Backcombing teases hair towards the roots so that it stands up fuller and looks denser.

clue.text: Highwayman outlawed by Speaker at one time

indicators.note: spoken by a speaker, the word for outlawed is heard rather than read

parts.note: outlawed means banned

explanation.surface: A robber of the roads who was once declared an outlaw by the Speaker of the House.
explanation.walkthrough: 'At one time' simply sets the scene of old-time highwaymen; 'Speaker' is not Parliament's Speaker but someone saying the word.
explanation.definitionFit: A highwayman was a mounted robber, a kind of outlaw who held up travellers.

clue.text: Screen is solid aluminium, with carbon inside

indicators.note: the carbon symbol sits inside the word for a solid shape

parts.note: a cone is a solid figure in geometry
C is the chemical symbol for carbon
Al is the chemical symbol for aluminium

explanation.surface: A chemistry note on a screen made of solid aluminium containing carbon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solid' reads as an adjective, but here it is a noun: a three-dimensional geometric figure.
explanation.definitionFit: To screen something is to hide it from view, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Oppose token performance

parts.note: a counter is a token used in games
an act is a performance on stage

explanation.surface: Objecting to a merely symbolic show.
explanation.definitionFit: To counteract something is to act against it, which is to oppose it.

clue.text: Forced to dance, in such clothes?

parts.note: made means forced, as in made to do something
taken as written
a measure is an old word for a stately dance

explanation.surface: Someone compelled to dance while wearing a particular sort of outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: MEASURE as a dance is literary, as in 'tread a measure'.
explanation.definitionFit: Tailored clothes cut for one person's own dimensions are described as bespoke in this way.

clue.text: Ravel medley

definitions.meaning: to ravel is to tangle or muddle
a medley is a mixed assortment

explanation.definitionFit: Both a tangle and a mixed assortment are a muddle of things, as is the verb to confuse.

clue.text: You say sap is rising in this tree

indicators.note: said out loud, the word you is the letter U

parts.note: you sounds like the letter U

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A remark about sap rising in a particular tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is rising' reverses SAP to PAS in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: The upas is a Javanese tree whose poisonous sap was used on arrows.

clue.text: 1 dn in gang holding doctor

indicators.note: one word is held inside the other

parts.note: a band is a group or gang
to doctor results is to rig them

explanation.surface: A highwayman in a gang that has kidnapped a doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: '1 dn' means the answer to 1 down, a highwayman. 'Doctor' is a verb here, not the physician.
explanation.definitionFit: A brigand is a bandit, a robber living outside the law.

clue.text: Sort of paint, say, woman will find good inside

indicators.note: good's letter goes inside the abbreviation for say

parts.note: e.g. means for example, or say
she will contracts to she'll

explanation.surface: A woman choosing paint who expects to find good stuff inside the tin.
explanation.definitionFit: Eggshell is a paint finish with a slight sheen, between matt and gloss.

clue.text: Sister whose son entered Promised Land

definitions.meaning: a religious sister is a member of a convent
in the Bible Joshua, who led Israel into Canaan

explanation.definitionFit: A religious sister and the father of Joshua share this one name.

clue.text: Promising enterprise

definitions.meaning: the act of promising, a pledge
a project or venture taken on

explanation.definitionFit: An undertaking is both a solemn pledge and a task or venture embarked upon.

clue.text: Behave arrogantly, as frisky horse did round long grass

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go round the grass word
a frisky horse jumps about, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: the rough is the long grass at the edge of a golf fairway

explanation.surface: A lively horse trampling around through tall grass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frisky' reads as describing the horse, but it is the anagram signal, and 'round' wraps the jumbled letters around the golf term for long grass.
explanation.definitionFit: To ride roughshod over others is an idiom for treating them arrogantly and without regard.

clue.text: Struggling pet I untied with clumsiness

indicators.note: something struggling is all over the place, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fumbling ineptly at a pet that has been set loose.
explanation.definitionFit: Ineptitude is a lack of skill or awkwardness, close in sense to clumsiness.

clue.text: Punch for party

explanation.definitionFit: Bash is slang both for a hard blow and for a party.

clue.text: Administrator arranging truce with Arab union

indicators.note: arranging letters puts them in a new order

explanation.surface: An official negotiating a ceasefire alongside an Arab union.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arranging' rearranges TRUCE, ARAB and U together.
explanation.definitionFit: A bureaucrat is an official who administers rules in a government department.

clue.text: Reverse picture on wall with a warning

indicators.note: the word for the picture is turned backwards

parts.note: a mural is a painting on a wall

explanation.surface: Flipping a wall painting over to reveal a warning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reverse' looks like an instruction to flip the picture over, but it simply turns the wall-painting word backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: An alarum is an archaic word for an alarm or call to arms.

clue.text: Old rune reworked into circular device

indicators.note: reworked letters are made into something new

explanation.surface: An ancient runic character remade into a round emblem.
explanation.definitionFit: A roundel is a circular disc or emblem, such as an aircraft's national marking.

clue.text: Self-control lacking in pupil

indicators.note: lacking means going without, so these letters are dropped

parts.note: discipline means self-control

explanation.surface: A student who shows no self-control.
explanation.definitionFit: A disciple is a follower or student of a teacher.

clue.text: Marks identifying one caught entering the country

indicators.note: the two letters go into the country's name

parts.note: India is the country in question
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Identification marks showing someone was caught coming into the country.
explanation.definitionFit: Indicia are distinguishing signs or marks, such as postal markings.

clue.text: Weaker, but made to hold instrument

indicators.note: the first word holds the second inside it

parts.note: did means made, as in did a meal
a lute is a stringed instrument

explanation.surface: A weakened person nonetheless forced to carry a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A diluted drink has been watered down, so it is weaker.

clue.text: Worried it's hard, presumably

definitions.meaning: something hard is not easy, read jokily as the answer

explanation.definitionFit: Feeling ill at ease means worried, and the word split also reads as not easy.

clue.text: French composer holding a top of tussore stuff

indicators.note: the composer's name holds the other letters inside

parts.note: Erik Satie was a French composer

indicators.note: the top of a down-clue word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A French composer clutching a piece of silk fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: To satiate is to fill to excess, the same as to stuff with food.

clue.text: Hostility as a virtuous circle expelled bishop

indicators.note: expelled means thrown out, so a letter is removed

parts.note: a nimbus is the halo around a saint's head
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: Ill feeling as a bishop is thrown out of a saintly ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Virtuous circle' is the saint's halo, not the economics phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Animus means animosity or ill will towards someone.

clue.text: Lily not using her last name

indicators.note: her refers to the lily, whose final letter is dropped

parts.note: a calla is a type of lily

explanation.surface: Lily decides to drop her surname.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not using her last' removes the final A from CALLA.
explanation.definitionFit: To call someone something is to name them.

clue.text: Press only a heavyweight would find simple to operate

parts.note: to press is to push
but means only, as in but a child
a ton is a heavy weight

explanation.surface: A newspaper press so stiff that only a very heavy person could work it.
explanation.definitionFit: Push-button machinery is worked by pressing a button, so is easy to use.

clue.text: Stupid person's waffle

definitions.meaning: to waffle is to talk at length

explanation.definitionFit: A goon is a fool, and to go on is to talk endlessly.

clue.text: Have a shot to persuade girl into pool

parts.note: to put is to throw the shot in athletics
taken as written
to get someone to do something is to persuade them
her stands for a girl

explanation.surface: Trying to coax a girl into the swimming pool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pool' is a verb here, to combine resources.
explanation.definitionFit: To pool resources is to combine them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: End of the road?

definitions.meaning: the A1(M) is a British motorway, written much like the answer

explanation.definitionFit: An aim is an end or objective one strives towards.

clue.text: No parking when waiting in terminal

indicators.note: no means without, so the parking letter is taken away

parts.note: pending means awaiting, until something happens
P is the abbreviation for parking on road signs

explanation.surface: A car park sign at an airport terminal forbidding waiting.
explanation.definitionFit: A terminal, as a noun, is an end point, much like a conclusion.

clue.text: She chooses what will make her content

definitions.text: She chooses what will make her content

parts.words: She chooses what will make her content
parts.note: a woman who selects material for a publication, its contents, rather than one choosing what pleases her

explanation.surface: A woman picking whatever will make her happy.
explanation.definitionFit: This old word is a female editor, who decides what goes into a publication.
